name: tiny-lib
goal: A tiny CommonJS library with two independent modules, each with node:test tests, plus an index that re-exports both.

agents.name: slug
agents.task: Create slug/index.js exporting function slugify(text): lower-case, trim, replace runs of non-alphanumerics with a single '-', no leading/trailing '-'. Create slug/slug.test.js using node:test and node:assert covering at least 4 cases. Run `node --test slug` and make it pass. Report in 2 lines.

agents.name: count
agents.task: Create count/index.js exporting function wordCount(text): number of whitespace-separated words (0 for empty/blank). Create count/count.test.js using node:test and node:assert covering at least 4 cases. Run `node --test count` and make it pass. Report in 2 lines.

agents.name: index
agents.task: Create index.js at the workspace root that re-exports slugify from ./slug and wordCount from ./count (CommonJS). Create index.test.js with node:test checking both are functions and one real call each. Run `node --test` and make everything pass. Report in 2 lines.
